dashboard.isolation: MainActor is appropriate for observable state and UI coordination. Annotation counts cannot distinguish short state updates from expensive feature work.

limitations: Matches are source matches: similarly named custom APIs may match; wrappers and unusual syntax may be missed.

findings.title: How does playback recover from an audio interruption?
findings.description: Preparation activates the audio session. No interruption or route-change observer was found. Define what the user should see when a call or audio-device change interrupts playback; this source review does not establish a reproduced failure.
findings.check: Exercise interruption, route change and media-services reset on device; assert the intended stop/resume and error behaviour.

findings.title: Should a failed preset decode erase the saved payload?
findings.description: The storage actor removes the preset key after any JSON decoding failure. That includes data the current schema cannot decode. Decide whether preserving or quarantining the payload would better support recovery.
findings.check: Test an unsupported schema and corrupt payload, including what remains available after a second load.
